summary: Tested the two Salon enhancements (venue gift badge on public invitation + QR poster tab in the venue panel) and the header 'Salon Girişi' discoverability CTA. All three items pass end-to-end. Backend GET /api/invitations/public/rozet-test-353349 returns venue_gift='Test Balo Salonu' and ahmet-yasemin-e9385d returns venue_gift=null. Public guest page shows data-testid 'venue-gift-badge' with correct text after clicking the 'Davetiye Aç' reveal button, and the normal free-theme invitation does NOT render the badge. Header cta-salon on /hizmetler navigates to /salon and venue-portal renders. After login (salon1@test.com / Test1234) the 4th tab 'QR Afiş' shows the poster tool: headline defaults to 'Test Balo Salonu', subtitle input present, live preview with QR canvas (150x150, target /davetiye-olustur), and clicking 'Afişi Yazdır / PDF' opens a print popup.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing rozet-test-353349 (free-code invitation from 'Test Balo Salonu') and ahmet-yasemin-e9385d (normal free-theme invitation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reveal animation requires clicking a visible 'Davetiye Aç' (or 'Aç'/'Atla') button before invitation content — including venue-gift-badge — becomes visible. Poster print button opens a real popup; capture with page.on('popup', ...). QR canvas has bounding_box width/height 150.
rca of the issue: No issue observed. Enhancement 1 (venue-gift-badge), Enhancement 2 (venue poster QR tab), and Discoverability (cta-salon) all working as specified.
